targets.notes: Invoice document item, mirroring the VBRP/EKPO conventions: BUZEI follows SAP numbering (Line_Number x10), pricing source columns are dropped as condition-driven, and each line carries its PO reference (EBELN/EBELP) so logistics invoice verification can match it against the goods receipt.

fields.sap_description: Document Number of an Invoice Document (staging key, must match the header)
Number of Line Item Within Accounting Document
Purchase Order Number (staging reference, from the header's PO -- RSEG items repeat it per SAP design)
fields.lookup_ref: Purchasing>Vendor Invoices -> header PO_ID -> EKKO-EBELN (denormalized header reference; resolvable at load via the header join)

dropped_fields.reason: SAP's own key is RSEG-BUZEI; kept only as an informal source row identifier, not loaded
denormalized in the source -- RSEG has no company code field, it is inherited from the header (RBKP-BUKRS)
pricing is fully condition-driven in MM (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), no flat RSEG field -- same treatment as EKPO/VBRP
item-level discount condition record (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), not a stored field
tax condition record result (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), not a stored field -- the tax CODE is carried via RSEG-MWSKZ

not_migrated_fields.reason: captured automatically as the entering SAP user
